title: Cancer competition for vitamin B2 creates metabolic checkpoint for T cell ferroptosis
title_zh: 肿瘤竞争维生素B2形成T细胞铁死亡的代谢检查点
abstract: Metabolic competition between tumors and T cells drives immune evasion, but the transporters and mechanisms remain largely elusive. Here, we establish the CareSLCs platform and identify that SLC52A3-mediated vitamin B2 (VB2) uptake is indispensable for T cell antitumor immunity. Mechanistically, VB2 deficiency impairs mitochondrial respiration and glutathione regeneration, leading to mitophagy, labile iron accumulation, and lipid peroxidation that trigger T cell ferroptosis. Unexpectedly, tumors preferentially employ SLC52A2, not SLC52A3, to scavenge VB2 and outcompete T cells. Tumor SLC52A2 ablation enhances T cell function in immunocompetent hosts without appreciably affecting intrinsic tumor growth. Clinically, high tumoral SLC52A2 correlates with T cell dysfunction and poor survival, whereas dietary VB2 intake is associated with reduced cancer risks. Thus, VB2 supplementation or SLC52A3 overexpression augments CAR-T cell antitumor efficacy. Our results suggest that tumoral VB2 competition establishes a metabolic checkpoint driving T cell ferroptosis and that enhancing VB2 uptake reinvigorates T cells to improve cancer immunotherapy.
abstract_zh: 代谢竞争是肿瘤与T细胞逃避免疫的关键机制，但相关转运蛋白和机制尚不清楚。我们构建了CareSLCs平台，发现SLC52A3介导的维生素B2（VB2）摄取对T细胞抗肿瘤免疫至关重要。机制上，VB2缺乏导致线粒体呼吸受损和谷胱甘肽再生受阻，进而诱发线粒体自噬、游离铁积累和脂质过氧化，最终触发T细胞铁死亡。令人意外的是，肿瘤更倾向于使用SLC52A2而非SLC52A3来获取VB2，从而抢占T细胞。敲除肿瘤SLC52A2可增强免疫健全宿主中的T细胞功能，而对肿瘤自身生长影响不大。临床上，肿瘤中高表达SLC52A2与T细胞功能障碍和较差生存率相关，而膳食VB2摄入则与降低癌症风险相关。因此，VB2补充或SLC52A3过表达可增强CAR‑T细胞的抗肿瘤效能。我们的研究表明，肿瘤对VB2的竞争形成了驱动T细胞铁死亡的代谢检查点，提升VB2摄取可重新激活T细胞，从而改善癌症免疫治疗。
